_about: The dashboard To-Do feed: a short, layman-readable daily checklist of curation work (for Sam) and engineering/pre-curation work (for Fable, the Claude session), rendered by cpl_todos.js as the 📋 To-Do button on every tab. Refreshed at every Rule-8 checkpoint alongside the session handoff (this file is the handoff distilled for the dashboard). Check-off state lives in each viewer's browser (localStorage) and resets when _as_of changes. Keep it SHORT — ≤ ~12 items; done items are deleted, not checked.
_status: SESSION 67 (Skywatch) — built the CPL News lane Sam asked for: a self-refreshing CPL News tab (#cpl-news) so the long-retired news section finally stays fresh WITHOUT hand-curation (the reason it died before). A daily Supabase Edge Function (cpl-news-harvest) harvests free sources — Google News, GDELT, CalMatters, CCCCO, Bluesky — plus a 'suggest a story' queue (how closed socials LinkedIn/X/FB/IG enter, via their link preview), Claude triages each item (on-topic? CA or national? one-sentence summary?), and the tab reads the result LIVE. Priority: California CPL first, national second, + adjacent systems (Career Passport, CA Master Plan, workforce/upskilling) + CA budget items. First run: 12 California items, avg relevance 0.84 (the Career Passport launch, the CCCCO earn-and-learn report, CA workforce-funding). Harvested news also auto-flows into the private CPLBrain vault digest; the PUBLIC knowledge base stays human-gated (not auto-written). PRs #481 (dashboard) + CPLBrain #9. docs/cpl_news_lessons.md.

items.text: NEW: the CPL News tab is LIVE — open it. It auto-harvests California CPL news first (Career Passport, workforce/upskilling, CA budget items) + national, every day, and Claude triages it — no hand-curation, so it won't go stale like last time. Eyeball the ~12 starter items, use ★ Feature / Hide to curate, and 'Suggest a story' to drop in any link (incl. a LinkedIn/X/Facebook/Instagram post — we read its preview). ONE DECISION for you: should harvested news also flow into the PUBLIC knowledge base, or stay private to our CPLBrain vault? (It's private-only right now, per the curation guardrail.)

Pick your college on the TMC Builder tab — every TMC shows whether you already have that ADT, split into ✓ Active (live in your catalog) vs ✓ Approved (CO-approved, pending activation) + ⏳ In progress / ◐ Teach-out. We're building this into a Chancellor's-Office REVIEW tool that checks a college's courses against each TMC's C-ID requirements automatically. Spot-check your college's badges and flag anything off.

To populate every approved ADT with its REAL course list, we need the MIS Data Mart 'Program Course File' for all ~115 colleges. Fable will hand you a Playwright script that drives your browser through every college unattended in ~10–15 min — run it once on your machine (it reaches datamart.cccco.edu; the agent sandbox can't), then upload the folder of CSVs. No rush.

The Knowledge Base tab is LIVE — sign in with your magic link and try the ✍️ New doc composer: write/paste notes, attach a file (text, PDF, Word, Excel, or a screenshot), ✨ Polish with Claude, then 'Open in GitHub →' to commit it as yourself. Please smoke-test ALL FIVE attachment types and flag any red error chip.

First Light's anonymous reflections can become a gentle weekly 'musings' digest for our private Obsidian vault (never the public site). It's READY; it just needs the service key on the cpl-knowledge-base repo. One-time step: add an Actions secret named SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY (the same Supabase service-role key the dashboard's daily sync uses) to cpl-knowledge-base.

✨ Suggested merges (data lane): groups by the obvious keyword (Algebra, the languages, ESL, Ballet, ECE/EMT/CNA/HVAC/LVN). Confirm the obvious families; UNCHECK or Skip a genuine progression (units are the tell). Popup tools: '➕ Add more courses by keyword', the 🏷 'match strength' slider, title-cleanup on a different target, and a 'Completion note' box.

395 college course titles carry encoding garbage at the source. The dashboard shows them repaired with a '⚠ fix in COCI' chip; the campaign list is kb/coci_title_corrections.json — take it to the colleges when ready.

CPL News follow-ups (after Sam reviews the feed): tune GOOGLE_NEWS_QUERIES + RELEVANCE_MIN (0.4) in the cpl-news-harvest function (mirror news/sources.json, redeploy via Supabase MCP — verify_jwt:false, capability-probe auth); optionally decode Google News opaque redirect URLs → final article links; add per-college/CCC official-site adapters + paid social if funded; consider RAG-ingesting summaries into cpl_documents so the CPL Assistant cites current news (needs the embedding pipeline). Docs: docs/cpl_news_lessons.md + playbook-cpl-news-aggregation.md.

PRIORITY (Sam: 'Go for A'): build the Phase-2 ACCEPTANCE ENGINE in tmc_builder.js — per-slot verdict from the ASCCC rules (C-ID match = ✓ accept · slot.flexible = ⚠ accept-with-ASSIST · specific C-ID filled by a non-match = faculty review · unfilled = ○ needs a course) + the structural checklist (major ≥18 sem · ≤60 · select-counts) + a 'Ready / N issues' banner. Consume slot.flexible + t.flexibility (#479). Demo on Allan Hancock vs San Diego City. Commit a jsdom test. Scope: docs/kb-notes/tmc-co-review-scope.md.

Write the Playwright bulk-PCF extractor for Sam to run (DevExpress College_MCF.aspx: per college select → View Report → Export CSV). Then tmc/_build_college_adt_courses.py joins PCF→COCI course list → per (college,ADT) real member courses + C-ID/units = the Phase-1 current-state bootstrap. Also: harden kb/college_short_names.json aliases; a C-ID-discrepancy export; faculty-verify the 45 drafts.

CCR data passes (queued, measure-first, own dry-run PRs): (1) the morphological-variant pass — Medical Assisting vs Assistant, the -ing/-ant/-ology family (lemmatize/stem the title token before _sug_sig); MEASURE regroup + over-merge first. (2) On Sam's go, DRY-RUN title-lane pass 2 (kb/_auto_merge_worklist.py --pass2-title); apply only on sign-off, then re-key Supabase + dispatch.
